title: Case #5 — HI gas kinematics in spiral galaxies (i = 10 deg)
description: SKA-Mid AA* observation of a synthetic spiral galaxy (pyHIARD model 1, P. Kamphuis) inclined at 10 deg, in the HI 21-cm line in Band 2. 20 min, 256 channels of 4.66 kHz (0.98 km/s) centred on 1393.98 MHz, so the band just covers the projected rotation at this inclination. Input cube resampled to 512 x 512 pixels of 0.75 arcsec, thermal noise from the AA* Band 2 SEFD, imaged channel by channel with WSClean multiscale at Briggs robust 1. One of three runs (i = 10, 45 and 80 deg) used for the moment maps and position-velocity diagrams.
